title: chrysanthemum hosmariense
intro: Chrysanthemum hosmariense, commonly known as the Korean chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum hosmariense are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
